choices.text: They may be considered as less loyal.

choices.text: They won't get the promotion opportunities.

choices.text: They should take more responsibility at work.

choices.text: They will be given hiring priority.

choices.text: She might not get a pay rise.

items.stem: By what means did scientists at University College London measure memory loss?

choices.text: By recording the time people spend on TV.
choices.zh: 通过记录人们看电视的时间。
通过追踪人们的生活习惯。

choices.text: By using memory and fluency tests.
choices.zh: 通过使用记忆力和流畅性测试。

items.stem: What contributed to memory decline in the participants?
What do the researchers say about their finding concerning the link between TV viewing and Alzheimer's disease?

choices.text: Television viewing may be a potential factor for Alzheimer's disease.
choices.zh: 看电视可能是阿尔茨海默病的一个潜在因素。

choices.text: Alzheimer's patients tend to watch television more than 3 hours a day.
choices.zh: 阿尔茨海默病患者往往每天看电视超过3小时。

choices.text: Some research has confirmed the link between them.
choices.zh: 一些研究已经证实了它们之间的联系。

choices.text: Television watching is beneficial to Alzheimer's patients.
choices.zh: 看电视对阿尔茨海默病患者有益。

items.stem: What do the researchers suggest older people do?

choices.text: Watch television no more than 3 hours each day.
choices.zh: 每天看电视不超过3小时。

choices.text: Balance television viewing with other contrasting activities.
choices.zh: 在看电视与其他对比性活动之间保持平衡。
观看一些教育类电视节目。
